title: God Tussi Great Ho
desc: Arun blames God for his troubles, but when God appears and grants him divine powers, Arun tries to make the world better by fulfilling everyone's wishes.

title: Bombay To Goa
desc: Mala, a young woman who witnesses a murder, flees on a Goa-bound bus. Along the way, she meets colourful travellers from different cultures and a spirited young man who refuses to leave her side.

title: Singh Is King
desc: Happy, known for his wild antics, is sent to bring Lakhan to his ailing father. In Australia, events take a turn as Happy accidentally assumes Lakhan's role as the local underworld king.

title: Baadshah
desc: A small time private detective gets embroiled in an industrialist's plot to assassinate a political leader.

title: Andaz Apna Apna
desc: Two ambitious rivals chase wealth by pursuing an heiress, but their plans spiral into confusion when a family plot and hidden identity create unexpected trouble.

title: Odela 2
desc: In a remote village with rich traditions, the savior Odela Mallanna Swamy always protects his people from evil forces.

title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
desc: A commoner named Prem swaps places with Prince Vijay Singh before a tense coronation. As plots unfold, Princess Maithili, meant to wed Vijay, finds herself drawn to Prem.

title: Commando 3
desc: Officers Karan and Bhavana travel to London on a high-stakes mission after uncovering a threat to India, racing against time to foil a planned terrorist attack.

title: Shubh Mangal Saavdhan
desc: Mudit, a shy boy, wins Sugandha's heart and plans marriage. But their relationship faces turmoil when they discover his erectile dysfunction, challenging their love before the wedding.

title: Gold
desc: Tapan Das takes charge of India's hockey team post-independence and battles challenges and odds to lead them toward Olympic glory and bring pride to the nation.

title: Race
desc: Two stepbrothers run a lavish stud farm and horse racing empire. When they fall for the same woman, jealousy turns deadly-one plots murder to claim love and insurance money.

title: Ram Lakhan
desc: Ram, a righteous cop, and Lakhan, his carefree brother, unite for revenge after discovering their father was murdered by two cunning criminals. Justice, drama, and brotherhood drive their journey.

title: Ghayal
desc: Ajay, wrongfully framed by Balwant Rai, teams up with fellow convicts for a thrilling quest for revenge. Together, they plot to reclaim his life and settle the score.

title: Simmba
desc: Simmba, a corrupt cop, works for smuggler Durva. But when Durva's brothers assault a woman, Simmba changes sides and seeks justice, risking everything to make things right.

title: Kantara: A Legend Chapter-1
desc: Set in pre-colonial Karnataka under the Kadamba dynasty, Bhuta Kola emerges as a sacred ritual, even as the legend of Kaadubettu Shiva quietly begins to take shape.

title: 420 Ipc
desc: CA Keswani is arrested for bank fraud and forgery. Keswani hires Birbal, a lawyer, to fight his case, but Birbal realises that there's more to it than meets the eye.
